lead.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5, its new frontier flagship
lead.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, claiming leadership in agentic coding and knowledge work at 40% lower running cost than Opus 5 on typical workloads. The launch lands days after the company filed its S-1 for a landmark IPO.

top_stories.title: Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4, its most realistic interactive world model
top_stories.summary: Genie 4 brings photorealism, advanced physics including aerodynamics and collisions, native audio, and real-time prompt-driven scene editing. Early access starts with trusted testers before reaching Google AI Ultra subscribers, API partners and AI Studio.

top_stories.title: Liquid AI releases LFM3, an open-weight multimodal model family
top_stories.summary: The ~2B-parameter family uses a tri-hybrid architecture spanning text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks, with LFM3-1.7B offering a 256K context window and a 38.4 score on WebArena-Verified. Weights are on Hugging Face with on-device optimization for 14 processor classes.

top_stories.title: Anthropic expands Claude to US government agencies at 40% discount
top_stories.summary: A new OneGov agreement with the General Services Administration makes Claude available to federal, state, local, tribal and territorial governments at a steep discount.

top_stories.title: Apple adds an AI assistant to Pages, Keynote and Numbers
top_stories.summary: A beta assistant drafts documents, builds animated slides and visualizes data across iWork, and the apps now support Model Context Protocol on macOS 27+ so third-party agents can plug in.

items.title: A scaling law for tool-use agents, from 849 models trained in synthetic environments
items.summary: The SynthAPI pipeline generates tool-use environments with controllable tool, task and database diversity; training 849 models on 458,752 tasks yields a law predicting agent generalization. As data budgets grow, scaling tool and database diversity beats adding more tasks of the same kind.

items.title: Heads of Security cuts prompt injection success from 97% to 10% with learned attention gates
items.summary: The HoS defense enforces instruction-data separation via per-head attention gates on GPT-OSS-20B, holding the RL-Hammer black-box attack at 10% success versus 85% for SecAlign, while beating SecAlign++ and ASIDE on adaptive attacks.

items.title: Metacognitive decoding makes diffusion language agents 20% cheaper to run
items.summary: A lightweight controller for diffusion LMs learns when to finalize tokens and how long to generate based on interaction needs, cutting inference FLOPs by 20.6% on average across five benchmarks without losing correctness.

items.title: Study finds latent world models aren't actually modeling environment dynamics
items.summary: The paper introduces latent rollout consistency, an equivariance metric for transition dynamics, and finds none of the studied state-of-the-art latent world models solve their tasks by faithfully modeling the environment.

items.title: How memory compression fails LLM group decisions, measured across 480 tasks
items.summary: CrossProfile shows relevance-based memory selection readmits on-topic decoy facts, losing 23-31 points to rarest-first selection in hidden-profile settings, while rarest-first discards widely shared evidence.

items.title: Together AI pitches MiniMax M3.1 Flash as an Opus 5.5 rival at ~27x lower cost
items.summary: The sparse-attention open-weights model ships 1M-token context and vision, and is positioned for coding, computer use and cybersecurity with reasoning_effort controls from low to max.

items.title: LMSYS spotlights miniTE, a low-precision training framework hitting 1.37x BF16 speed
items.summary: InfiX.ai's miniTE delivers 1.33-1.37x speedup on BF16 learner updates across 8xB300 GPUs, attacking the training-sampling mismatch with quantization diagnostics and a TRIAGE mechanism for risky updates.

items.title: Together AI maps the open-source AI stack as independent, swappable layers
items.summary: The breakdown treats model, inference, gateway/router, harness and tools as mix-and-match layers, arguing the open-weights ecosystem has matured into stack-level composability rather than a parameter-count race.

items.title: China unveils Neo1, a 13-foot humanoid that can lift a cow
items.summary: NeoDynamics unveiled Neo1 at the China International Industry Fair, a giant humanoid built for heavy assembly, mining and disaster-zone debris removal in harsh environments.

items.title: Apple brings the M6 chip to the iMac with a claimed major AI boost
items.summary: The new iMac adds cores and Neural Accelerators in each GPU core, plus Wi-Fi 7 and faster memory.

items.title: Apple refreshes the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 and 1TB base storage
items.summary: The entry-level MacBook Pro ships a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, Wi-Fi 7 and up to 24 hours of battery life.

items.title: Cargo thieves spoof GPS to steal $100M+ in data center hardware since June
items.summary: Organized crews exploit GPS spoofing rather than trailer locks to intercept servers, memory and drives headed for US data centers.

items.title: Firefox Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
items.summary: 'Fill from sources' drafts form-field suggestions via Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite from open tabs, and a '/watch' command monitors pages for price drops or new listings with notifications.

items.title: Binary: an MCP-friendly applicant tracking system for startups
items.summary: A hiring tool built so AI coding agents and assistants can interact with the recruiting workflow directly.

items.title: SelfClaw: self-hosted multi-model AI chat with an OpenAI-compatible API
items.summary: An open-source, self-hosted chat app that fronts multiple models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.title: PVisor: VM-isolated containers for sandboxing AI agents
items.summary: DeepLink-org's PVisor provides virtual-machine-isolated containers designed to safely confine agent execution.

items.title: CleanCode: Claude Code and Codex collaborating on one canvas
items.summary: An open-source canvas that lets both coding agents work side by side on the same task.

items.title: Alterna pivots from generic agents to vertical AI suites
items.summary: The Italian firm and top Microsoft partner unveiled industry-specific agent suites for manufacturing, fashion, food and beverage, professional services and utilities.

items.title: ChinaEU and UBTECH sign robotics deal, with Italy as possible humanoid testbed
items.summary: The agreement targets advanced robotics for manufacturing and logistics in Europe; ChinaEU president Luigi Gambardella flagged Italy as a possible laboratory for humanoid robots.

items.title: General Compute raises $100M Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
items.summary: Blackbird and Abstract led the round at an $800M post-money valuation, up from $60M at its May seed, anchored by a $400M SambaNova chip deal and a $100M-ARR customer.

items.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund for big bets on at least 10 companies
items.summary: The firm's first blind-pool fund targets late-stage checks of up to $1B in AI and defense; past bets include Groq and ElevenLabs.

items.title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B
items.summary: General Catalyst and JPMorganChase's Strategic Investment Group led the raise for the hard-tech manufacturing accelerator to expand US capacity and launch new industrial startups.

items.title: Nvidia backs Simplismart, the Indian startup running AI models with fewer GPUs
items.summary: A $14M Series B led by Dallas Venture Capital values the inference-optimization startup at about $100M and funds US expansion.
